Speech.NativeText: What's up?
:-( I'm infected. The eyes... they were white. When I turn... make it quick.
8-[ I've been bitten! It's Red Strain! Help me!

:-( I've been bitten! I need some Green Strain antigen.

:-( Feeling... faint. Need.. bandages.

:-) Shot any bunnies lately? My belly's a-rumblin'.

{:-( I wish my %1 %2 was here!
